{
  "name": "spatial.submit",
  "category": "spatial",
  "purpose": "Submit batched nearest, sphere overlap or continuous moving-sphere sweep queries.",
  "when_to_use": "Reusable batch collision and spatial queries (空間查詢、批次碰撞查詢) on CPU or host-owned GPU compute; gameplay policy remains in Luau. Read docs/spatial-batches.md and examples/spatial-diagnostics/README.md (bundled in the portable SDK) for the complete query, result, diagnostic, lifecycle, limits and host contracts; game api typings provides canonical SpatialBody, SpatialQuery, SpatialBatchResult, SpatialInfo and EngineDiagnostic types.",
  "when_not_to_use": "No AI, movement integration, damage, scene mutation or renderer replacement. V1 uses bounded complete scans, not an accelerated grid.",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "index",
      "type_name": "number",
      "meaning": "Live index handle"
    },
    {
      "name": "queries",
      "type_name": "SpatialQuery[]",
      "meaning": "0..1024 queries; mask and exclude_id are generic geometric filters. Annotate a stored query as SpatialNearestQuery, SpatialOverlapQuery or SpatialSweepQuery before table.insert to preserve its literal kind"
    }
  ],
  "returns": "number: ticket",
  "side_effects": [
    "Updates bounded spatial handles and frozen batch snapshots; rejection records a structured diagnostic without changing the original thrown error text"
  ],
  "frame_semantics": "Submit/take/cancel only in update; results become visible starting the next tick. Equal-distance/time ties use ascending numeric ID. Overlap returns at most 64 contacts and explicitly errors on overflow. GPU f32 results have a documented tolerance; no bitwise cross-device promise.",
  "common_errors": [
    "Invalid/non-finite records, duplicate IDs, stale handles, early take, pending host completion, capacity and contact overflow fail explicitly."
  ],
  "example": "local query: SpatialNearestQuery = {kind=\"nearest\",point={0,0,0},max_distance=10}; local queries: {SpatialQuery} = {}; table.insert(queries, query); ticket = api.spatial.submit(index, queries)",
  "related_apis": [
    "spatial.create",
    "spatial.pack",
    "spatial.submit",
    "spatial.take",
    "spatial.info",
    "spatial.lastDiagnostic",
    "spatial.profile"
  ]
}
